study_type: Retrospective speaker-disjoint exploratory comparison; historical outer outcomes were previously inspected. All new graph policies fixed before new outer metrics.

strategies.name: full_graph_da
strategies.candidate_policy: All 39 phones; cached fixed generic graph evidence.

training_neighbor_source: Only stable, diagnostic observed directed substitutions in outer training patients; leave-own-patient-out for training features; min raw count 1; no added unseen edges.
selection: Union per-frame top-k nonblank phones with raw posterior >=0.01. Add observed training neighbors for SUB only. No boundaries, PHN or complete-graph pass used by acoustic selector.
pruning_semantics: Retain all acceptable OK paths and epsilon DEL. Prune SUB and INS before inference, preserve original arc weights without renormalization. CTC blank remains a distinct frame symbol.
adaptation: Original Graph+DA feature transform, model family, patient weighting, development selection and calibration; historical CF reweighting is absent.
classifier_selection: Development-patient average precision; ties use listed order.
calibration: Nondecreasing Platt fit and F1 threshold on development patient only.
one_pass_policy: Freeze all outer predictions before evaluation joins test labels. Report all four policies. Do not refit or select graph policies from new test results.
resource_policy: Separate warmed single-process CPU pilot includes selection, graph construction and sum/max inference, with legacy-full and full-compacted controls; cached-logit loading and the unchanged encoder are excluded. Parallel experiment timings are not resource claims.
memory_policy: Report named graph and DP arrays only; no claim that these equal process peak memory.
literature_policy: TORGO speaker-specific published substitutions motivate data-derived graph restriction but are not hard-coded, because published source speakers overlap evaluation patients. PP-AF generic phonology and Mandarin PhoenixDSR confusions are not relabeled as an English dysarthria confusion table.
